text: Let |G| = 15. What do the Sylow theorems force?
choices: n₃ = n₅ = 1, both Sylow subgroups are normal, and G ≅ ℤ/15ℤ
Nothing — several non-isomorphic groups of order 15 exist
explanation: n₃ ≡ 1 (mod 3) and n₃ | 5 force n₃ = 1; n₅ ≡ 1 (mod 5) and n₅ | 3 force n₅ = 1. The two normal Sylow subgroups intersect trivially and commute, so G ≅ ℤ/3ℤ × ℤ/5ℤ ≅ ℤ/15ℤ is the unique group of order 15.
